verdict.rationale: The only documented event-triggered automation is auto-shutdown. Users set an inactivity threshold (one hour to one week) that automatically stops a machine, which is a single preset rule rather than a general rules engine. Workflows automate ML pipelines, but the evidence never says they can be triggered by events. Missing for 10: user-defined event-to-action rules, choice of event types (e.g. job completion, resource state changes), configurable actions beyond stopping a machine, event triggers for Workflows, and hands-on corroboration.
